summary: Local Host API, Project Loro owner, Asset CAS, executable-provider bridge, and SQLite-backed Durable Run adapter.
architecture_notes: @clash/shared-runtime owns the only Durable Run phases, retry policy, and step graph; local-api supplies SQLite journal, executor adapters, Resource staging, Project publication, and restart scheduling.

New media bytes are first stored as an unsealed Host-private staging receipt. asset-inspection/v4 derives canonical byte facts before LocalResourceStore seals an immutable L0 Resource; Project/Global entries and output bindings publish only after that boundary succeeds.

Project/Global import commands carry caller-preallocated stable Asset ids. Caller media metadata is a hint only; v4 Host facts own display geometry, rotation, duration, stream presence, codecs, sample rate, channel count, and channel layout.

Provider plugins translate one submit or poll step. Timeline render and built-in local-acp/local-tts use targetKind=local-executor but advance through the same engine rather than synchronous execution loops.

Media execution is at-least-once. local-durable-output-staging.ts consumer-CASes one staging receipt by projectId + actionRunId + outputSlot; Project Asset and ActionAssetBinding facts appear only after v4 finalization in the publication checkpoint. Pre-v4 sealed receipts are re-verified and copied back to unsealed staging before recovery continues.
Timeline render freezes its Timeline Action revision and input bindings, uses outputSlot render:output, and recovers from the journal without client resubmission.

New Canvas Provider, Host-local, and custom plugin runs use a finalized-executor revision-scoped actionRunId and a separate mutable-node projection CAS fingerprint. Legacy base-key rows recover consumer outputs fail-closed and never reserve or project the current node.
Project Loro exposes only coarse status and Asset lineage. Provider tokens, attempts, deadlines, staging receipts, local paths, and raw failures remain Host-private in SQLite.

The personal Global Asset service performs one fail-closed migration of current-user legacy assets plus asset_library_refs through Resource staging and v4 inspection; canonical entries and its completion marker commit atomically, after which legacy membership is never rescanned.
Poster frames, waveforms, and Timeline filmstrips are disposable frontend caches in Current Local. They are not L1 facts, Durable steps, publication gates, or backend representations.

key_files.src/local-processor.ts: Composes the shared engine with Provider, plugin Action, and Host-local executor adapters plus Project publication.
key_files.src/durable-run-coordinator.ts: Freezes executor input and maps one executable invocation into one shared DurableRunEngine step.
key_files.src/local-durable-output-staging.ts: Stable consumer-CAS receipt for at-least-once Host-local media output.
key_files.src/local-resource-store.ts: Unsealed byte staging and canonical L0 Resource sealing; staged bytes are not readable as Resources before successful inspection. Pre-v4 compatibility rows remain explicitly unverified until one complete v4 probe promotes the canonical kind/media facts by CAS.
key_files.src/local-asset-inspections.ts: Versioned asset-inspection/v4 byte probe and L1 fact receipt used by every new Local media publication, including safe promotion of old unverified or no-MIME Resource rows.
key_files.src/local-metadata-store.ts: SQLite metadata store, including the rebuildable typed metadata-attachment query projection; it is not Project authority.
key_files.src/sync.ts: Project Loro owner and journal-driven wake scheduler; peer sync cannot author Project Asset authority or frozen/run-owned Asset bindings.
key_files.src/timeline-durable-workflow.test.ts: Timeline/local-acp/local-tts journal, restart, and output-winner integration evidence.
